row.title: QUEUE-PORT-1 and BRANCH-SWEEP-4: PORT-BRANCH items were invisible to the queue
row.body: foundation/queue.py read only OL-*.json and Q-*.json, so the 76 PORT-BRANCH items the branch sweep filed were never offered to the executor, never probed and never closed. The queue now reads PORT-BRANCH-*.json. The closing probe (branchsweep --carried) now measures how many of the code lines a branch added are on main (doctrine/branchsweep.json carried: min_share 0.95, max_missing_lines 10), reports the files main lacks otherwise, and answers unmeasured in a shallow checkout; fleet.yml checks out full history so the server can run it. 2026-11-19: 38 items closed with probe evidence (14 branch gone, 24 carried), 38 stay open with the missing files named.
